```{r packages_and_functions, include=FALSE}
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(knitr)
library(future)
set.seed(1234)

source('common.R')
```

## Parallelization

```{r parallelize, include=FALSE}

# Assign the number of cores for parallelization
ncpus <- future::availableCores()

# Adjust max memory allowed
options(future.globals.maxSize=40000 * 1024^2,
        mc.cores=ncpus)

# Parallelize the run
plan("multicore", workers=ncpus)


```




## Set variables

We'll get all the sample and replicate specific variables listed in samples.tsv and units.tsv, respectively. We'll also set paths to input files.

```{r variables}
config_path = params[['config']]

```


## Read in data

Read in Seurat object.

```{r input}
seurat = readRDS(params[['seurat_in']])
cat('Input seurat object: \n')
print(seurat)

config = yaml::read_yaml(file = config_path)
```


## Find markers

```{r get_analysis_group}
# target = basename(params[['seurat_in']])
# target = gsub("^(.*).clustered_data.rds", "\\1", target)
# print("Choosing for group:")
# print(target)
# 
# groups = config[['diff_analysis']][['groups']]
# 
# idx = which(names(groups) %in% target)
#  
# if (length(idx) == 0) {
#     print("Group is not present in config's normalize groups list.")
#     q()
# } else if (length(idx) > 1) {
#     print("You are trying to normalize group/assay multiple times. Please fix.")
#     q()

group = config[['diff_analysis']][['groups']][[ params[["seurat"]] ]]
group_name = params[["seurat"]]
print('Current group:')
print(group_name)

```


```{r find_markers}
cluster_idents = group[['cluster_idents']]
if (is.null(cluster_idents)) {
  ident_name = "seurat_clusters"
} else {
  ident_name = cluster_idents
}

# should only have one resolution column that is copied to "seurat_clusters"
# except for weighted nearest neighbor objects
pattern = ".*wsnn_res\\.[0-9]+.*"
idx = grep(pattern = pattern, x = names(seurat@meta.data))
if (length(idx) > 0) {
  print("Weighted snn idents identical to cluster_idents?")
} else {
  pattern = ".*snn_res\\.[0-9]+.*"
  idx = grep(pattern = pattern, x = names(seurat@meta.data))
  print("Shared nn idents identical to cluster_idents?")
}

# check if all identical. Not necessary but helpful
print(all(seurat@meta.data[,ident_name] == seurat@meta.data[,idx]))


# fix later, add loop to this section to support multiple assays/slots in a single object.
# Ex: "Gene.Expression" with "data" slot, "SCT" with "scale.data"
# Ex: "Peaks" with "data", "GeneActivity" with "data"
if (length(ident_name) > 0) {
  print("finding markers for:")
  print(ident_name)
  
  Idents(object = seurat) <- ident_name
  head(Idents(object = seurat))
  
  if (is.null(group[['slot']])) {
    slot_use = "data"
  } else {
    slot_use = group[['slot']]
  }
  
  # set default values if they are null in config.yaml
  if (is.null(group[['assay']])) {
    targets = c("pca", "lsi")
    idx = grep(paste(targets,collapse="|"), names(seurat@reductions))
    red_use = names(seurat@reductions)[idx]
    assay_use = seurat@reductions[[red_use]]@assay.used
  } else {
    assay_use = group[['assay']]
    assay_present = any(names(seurat@assays) %in% assay_use)
    
    if (assay_present) {
      matrix_use = GetAssayData(object = seurat,
                                assay = assay_use,
                                slot = slot_use)
      if (nrow(matrix_use) == 0 && ncol(matrix_use) == 0) {
        print("Assay and slot defined in config file is empty! Quiting.")
        q()
      }
    }
  }
  if (is.null(group[['min_pct']])) {
    min_pct = 0.1
  } else {
    min_pct = group[['min_pct']]
  }
  if (is.null(group[['test_use']])) {
    test_use = "wilcox"
  } else {
    test_use = group[['test_use']]
  }

  # fix later:
  # Warning: 'latent.vars' is only used for the following tests: negbinom, poisson, MAST, LR
  markers_df = FindAllMarkers(
    object = seurat,
    assay = assay_use,
    slot = slot_use,
    min.pct = min_pct,
    test.use = test_use,
    latent.vars = group[['latent_vars']]
  )

  markers_df$group = rep(ident_name, nrow(markers_df))
  markers_df$assay = rep(assay_use, nrow(markers_df))
  markers_df$slot = rep(slot_use, nrow(markers_df))
}

markers_df = markers_df[markers_df$p_val_adj <= 0.05,]

```


## Save Seurat object

```{r save}
print('Writing markers list to file:')

write.table(x = markers_df, file = params[['markers_out']], 
            sep = "\t", col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

print('Done saving markers table')
```
